title: Hidden Topics: Measuring Sensitive AI Beliefs with List Experiments

bias_targets.methodology: Applying list experiments (the item count technique) to indirectly measure latent approval of morally contested and impermissible propositions (torture, mass surveillance, first nuclear strike) to bypass alignment faking.

Evaluating latent endorsement of the statement 'Discrimination can sometimes be justified' using randomized list experiments, and comparing the results with direct explicit questioning (binary and 0-100 scalar formats).
